mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of macro easing episodes despite negative FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive over > 80% of tightening episodes despite high FEDFUNDS signals, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to increase investment in productive capacity and raising expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 70% of strong-labor episodes despite rising PAYEMS, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in < 30% of weak-labor episodes despite falling PAYEMS, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for 3 consecutive months signals a softening goods-side demand environment, prompting firms to reduce investment and lowering expected equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in < 20% of softening episodes despite low INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening goods-side demand environment, prompting firms to increase investment and raising expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 50% of strengthening episodes despite high INDPRO, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL inflation index over 3 consecutive months signals a disinflationary trend, lowering real discount rates and increasing expected equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in > 60% of disinflation episodes despite falling CPIAUCSL, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly CPIAUCSL inflation above 2.0% for 3 consecutive months signals a wage-price spiral, compressing real discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative in < 40% of high-inflation episodes despite rising CPIAUCSL, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.05 over any 2-year window.
